scope: Engine runtime abstraction split for GitHub issues 35-37: root engine facade, caller-owned camera/view rendering, app-owned input, app-owned event dispatch, and dogfood migration proof.

phase_reports.summary: Baseline drift was repaired or classified before implementation, including camera look-at compatibility and stale render target cleanup.
The root engine crate now exposes a thin facade, prelude, raw primitive reexports, and FrameClock while preserving launcher behavior.
Renderer caller-view APIs accept CameraView and support no-dispatch rendering without forcing renderer-owned camera/input/event state.
Input routing and InputActionEventEmitter support one app-owned dispatch per frame while preserving raw input primitives.
RuntimeEventDispatcher and runtime_event_bus provide app-owned lifecycle/input stages with raw EventBus access still available.
dungeon_dogfood migrated to app-owned input/events/camera/frame state and caller-provided CameraView rendering.
Specs, docs, knowledge, changelog, stale-reference classification, final command suite, and final review were completed.
